Whether you’re in your garden, a forest, close to home or in another country, Planto is the benchmark application on the AppStore for scanning plants, flowers, trees or any other vegetation you come across.

Features:
* SCAN all plants in your path
* LEARN all the characteristics (species, taxonomy, etc.) of the plants through the various explanations of our experts
* CREATE your own garden and keep all your plants in one place
* CARE for your plants and learn everything about them to ensure that they stay healthy
* SEARCH for any plant in the world with our database of over 10,000 plants

User feedback:
- "A real treasure trove of information for enthusiasts."
- "Quick, fun, intuitive and a great way to finally get to know your surroundings."
- "A very useful app that’s helped me save many of my plants."
- "To all those who are curious about the plants around them, this application offers a simple and effective tool."
